method: Bare-metal wall-clock timing. CPU commands were pinned with taskset -c 0 and OMP_NUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, BLIS_NUM_THREADS, and NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS were all set to 1.
workload: HfO2 smooth CHGCAR, concatenated PBE Hf_pv+O POTCAR, PBE, 520 eV, 60 bands, Gamma point, 3407 plane waves, complex128 generalized Hermitian eigensystem.

half_cuda_rtx_pro_6000.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

scope: This is a workload-matched performance record. HfO2 eigenvalue parity between HALF and HAPPY remains a separate validation gate.
